authorized_source_namespace: official ALFWorld json_2.1.1/train static files only
byte_authentication_contract: For every authorized train member, parse its local ZIP header from the authenticated train-only span and require exact central/local filename binding.
Decompress only supported stored/deflate methods; verify central-directory CRC32 and uncompressed size.
Require byte-for-byte SHA256 equality between official train member bytes and the local installed train-relative file.
Require exact local train file-set equality: unknown, missing or duplicate relative paths fail closed.
Canonical manifest is newline-terminated UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False and lexicographic relative_path order.
semantic_guard: STATIC_GRAPH_REPLAYABILITY_ONLY; historical local_source_competence_preoutcome is superseded and forbidden, not additionally required
snapshot_binding_contract: future V2 source snapshot must be externally paired in PLANCARRY_CPDS_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_PROVENANCE_ENVELOPE_V1 with exact official_static_source_authority_sha256 and source_snapshot_sha256 before certificate use
source_graph_unit_rule: trial relative directory contains game.tw-pddl + initial_state.pddl + traj_data.json; structural completeness only; no model/behavior/outcome competence predicate
transport_contract: HEAD metadata only; body GET must be HTTP 206 with exact Content-Range.
EOCD access is exactly the final 22 bytes and requires zero ZIP comment; central-directory access is exactly the EOCD-declared range.
Classify local records from central-directory metadata before body access; only json_2.1.1/train/ local-record intervals are authorized.
Every non-train local-record interval, including valid_seen, valid_unseen and valid_train, is forbidden for body access.
Authorized train local-record spans may be subdivided into deterministic chunks; every chunk must remain wholly inside an authorized train span.
Never reconstruct/cache/hash the complete release archive; archive-level SHA256 is intentionally absent under the no-heldout-body-access rule.
